meta.criteriaIntro: We include an option when we can point to a public page for what it is, who it is for, and either a published price or a clear statement that the price is not public. We skip lookalikes we could not verify. We do not score stars. We do not invent results.
criteria: The seller has a live site we opened on or after 2026-09-15, or an IRS or FTC page that states the rule.
The option teaches money, tax, real estate, or a money habit. Pure software lead tools sit in other roundups.
Price is copied from a public page, or we say the price is not published.
We say who wrote this and that Legacy Investing Show sells its own programs.
We link out to the seller so you can check the live offer.
meta.disclosure: Legacy Investing Show wrote this. We sell education and coaching, including [Legacy Wealth Blueprint](/legacy-wealth-blueprint). This is not an independent review. We do not pose as a customer. We list public facts, then say who may fit each option. Confirm any price or term on the seller's page before you pay.
meta.legal: This is education, not tax, legal, or investment advice. It is not an offer to sell a program. Results vary. A licensed professional should review your own facts before you act.
